name: migration
description: Discover, partition, migrate, and integrate disjoint ownership slices.

tasks.prompt: Map the migration goal {{var:GOAL}}. Derive objectively verifiable acceptance items, define contracts, source-grounded paths or symbols, compatibility constraints, exact verification commands, rollback evidence, and disjoint ownership slices. Map every acceptance item and recorded decision to a slice and the integration review; require a thin end-to-end tracer first when the integration design is unproven.
acceptance: Returns a scoped map with concrete evidence paths, causal dependencies, and named unknowns.

tasks.prompt:
Implement only ownership slice A and its assigned acceptance items for {{var:GOAL}}. Run its exact narrow checks and report observed acceptance coverage.
{{output:migration-plan}}
acceptance: Completes only the owned scope and reports exact verification commands and observed results.

tasks.prompt:
Implement only ownership slice B and its assigned acceptance items for {{var:GOAL}}. Run its exact narrow checks and report observed acceptance coverage.
{{output:migration-plan}}
acceptance: Completes only the owned scope and reports exact verification commands and observed results.
Returns explicit pass, revise, or blocked coverage for every declared upstream criterion.
